glossary.LFPR: Labour Force Participation Rate - percentage of the population in the labour force (working or seeking work).
glossary.WPR: Worker Population Ratio - percentage of employed persons in the population of age 15 years and above.
glossary.UR: Unemployment Rate - percentage of the labour force that is unemployed.
glossary.PLFS: Periodic Labour Force Survey - annual household survey conducted by NSO for employment/unemployment indicators.
glossary.NSO: National Statistical Office - apex statistical body under MoSPI, Government of India.
glossary.MoSPI: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation - responsible for official statistics in India.
glossary.CWS: Current Weekly Status - activity status of a person during the reference week preceding the date of survey.
glossary.Worker Share: Worker Share (percent) - statistical indicator extracted from the source document.
glossary.Average Weekly Hours: Average Weekly Hours (hours_per_week) - statistical indicator extracted from the source document.
glossary.Average Monthly Earnings: Average Monthly Earnings (INR) - statistical indicator extracted from the source document.
glossary.Employment Status: Employment Status - statistical indicator extracted from the source document.
glossary.Gender: Gender - classification dimension with categories: Male, Female, Persons.
glossary.Sector: Sector - classification dimension with categories: Rural, Urban.
glossary.Age Group: Age Group - classification dimension with categories: 15 years and above, 15-29 years, 15-59 years.
glossary.Industry: Industry - classification dimension with categories: Agriculture, Manufacturing, Construction, Services, Other.
glossary.Activity Status: Activity Status - classification dimension with categories: Usual Status (ps+ss), CWS.
